source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul pe 9 octombrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Andronic»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Οκτωβρίου — «Όσιοι Ανδρόνικος και Αθανασία η συμβία του»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», and the entry is the same couple: the well-off husband and wife of Antioch in Syria, he a money-changer, who lost their two children, went on pilgrimage to the Holy Land and then to Egypt, and by common decision became monastics — he in the monastery of the abba Daniel, she in the women's monastery of the Tabennesiotes — and fell asleep in peace. The page states «έζησαν κατά το έτος 540 μ.Χ.», so a `dates` object is proposed from its own words. It records a portion of the relics of each of them at the monastery of Kykkos in Cyprus. The page prints a proper apolytikion that names them both, taken here, and an «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον», the common «Τῆς ἐρήμου πολίτης», which names Andronicus alone and is taken for his folder only. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Locuitor pustiului, înger în trup şi de minuni făcător te-ai arătat, purtătorule de Dumnezeu, Părintele nostru Andronic. Cu postul, cu privegherea şi prin rugăciune primind daruri cereşti, tămăduieşti pe cei bolnavi şi sufletele celor ce aleargă la tine cu credinţă. Slavă Celui Ce ţi-a dat ţie putere; Slavă Celui Ce te-a încununat pe tine; Slavă Celui Ce lucrează prin tine tuturor tămăduiri.

english.text: A dweller of the desert, an angel in the body and a wonderworker thou wast shown to be, our God-bearing father Andronicus. By fasting, by vigil and by prayer thou didst receive heavenly gifts, and thou healest the sick and the souls of them that run to thee in faith. Glory to him who gave thee strength; glory to him who crowned thee; glory to him who through thee worketh healings for all.

hymns.text: Σωφροσύνης τὴν χλαῖναν τὴν θεούφαντον, κατεποικίλατε χρόαις τῶν ἱερῶν ἀρετῶν, ὁμοφρόνως ἐν σπουδῇ ἄμφω ἀσκήσαντες, ὅθεν ὑμῶν τὴν σιωπήν, ἡ τρισάγιος ᾠδή, ἐδέξατο ἐν ὑψίστοις, Ἀνδρόνικε σὺν τὴ θεία, Ἀθανασία τὴ Θεόφρονι.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. α’, Τὸν συνάναρχον Λόγον — the first hymn on the page of «Όσιοι Ανδρόνικος και Αθανασία η συμβία του», and it names them both.

english.text: You embroidered the God-woven mantle of chastity with the colours of the sacred virtues, both of you living in asceticism with one mind and with zeal; and so the thrice-holy song received your silence in the highest, Andronicus, with the divine and God-minded Athanasia.

hymns.text: Τῆς ἐρήμου πολίτης, καὶ ἐν σώματι ἄγγελος, καὶ θαυματουργὸς ἀνεδείχθης, θεοφόρε πατὴρ ἡμῶν Ἀνδρόνικε, νηστείᾳ, ἀγρυπνίᾳ, προσευχῇ, οὐράνια χαρίσματα λαβών, θεραπεύεις τοὺς νοσοῦντας, καὶ τὰς ψυχάς των πίστει προστρεχόντων σοι· Δόξα τῷ δεδωκότι σοι ἰσχύν, δόξα τῷ σὲ στεφανώσαντι, δόξα τῷ ἐνεργοῦντι διὰ σοῦ πᾶσιν ἰάματα.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος α’, Τοῦ λίθου σφραγισθέντος — the second hymn on the page of «Όσιοι Ανδρόνικος και Αθανασία η συμβία του». It is the common of a venerable father, printed with his name in it, «θεοφόρε πατὴρ ἡμῶν Ἀνδρόνικε», and names no other saint; it is taken for his folder alone.

english.text: You were shown to be a citizen of the desert, an angel in the body and a wonderworker, our God-bearing father Andronicus; by fasting, vigil and prayer you received heavenly gifts, and you heal the sick and the souls of those who run to you in faith. Glory to him who gave you strength, glory to him who crowned you, glory to him who works healings for all through you.
